name: Hightouch
description: Hightouch is a data activation platform for syncing governed warehouse data into business applications, advertising platforms, customer engagement tools, and operational systems. Its products include Reverse ETL, Customer Studio, models, sources, destinations, syncs, journeys, experimentation, event collection, personalization, and AI decisioning.
agentUseSummary: Add a separate Admin-created Hightouch workspace API key; agents can read only an identity-free aggregate model count through one fixed endpoint.

credentialRequirements.name: HIGHTOUCH_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Hightouch API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a separate Admin-issued workspace API key for Relay, store it securely, and revoke it if exposure is suspected. Hightouch documents that keys carry read/write access even though Relay only mounts one read.

capabilities.label: Read model readiness summary
capabilities.description: Count workspace models while excluding model identity, definitions, SQL, sources, destinations, syncs, runs, profiles, and customer data.

approvalRequired.label: Get Hightouch model readiness summary
approvalRequired.description: Return only the aggregate model count from the fixed Hightouch Models API endpoint.

blocked.label: Access model identity, definition, or query
blocked.description: Model and audience IDs, names, descriptions, query types, SQL, configuration, schemas, columns, primary keys, and related metadata remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access profiles, records, events, or customer data
blocked.description: Profiles, identities, records, row values, events, attributes, behaviors, traits, audiences, memberships, PII, consent, and raw customer data remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access sources, destinations, syncs, or runs
blocked.description: Connections, credentials, source/destination identity, sync configuration, mappings, schedules, runs, row and operation counts, errors, logs, and delivery state remain blocked.

blocked.label: Trigger, create, update, delete, or administer Hightouch
blocked.description: Sync triggers, full resync, CDC reset, tests, models, audiences, journeys, campaigns, experiments, users, groups, roles, keys, settings, and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, methods, headers, queries, bodies, filters, pagination, polling, retries, CLI, MCP, SDKs, browser sessions, bulk, and exports remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded model count requires approval; identity, definitions, customer data, syncs, runs, triggers, writes, administration, raw APIs, and bulk remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bounded count runs directly; workspace ownership, key authority, redaction, response cap, audits, and provider limits remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives one fixed identity-free Hightouch model-count wrapper.
Hermes receives the same fixed Hightouch wrapper.

providerSetup.blocker: Hightouch requires an Admin-created workspace API key that provides read/write access to sensitive resources; safe use requires a separate key, correct workspace/access confirmation, secure storage, network compatibility, rotation/revocation planning, and live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A workspace Admin creates a separate API key, confirms it resolves only the intended workspace and model access, accounts for network controls, records rotation/revocation ownership, and completes a live read-only acceptance check.

evidence.supports: Hightouch documents Admin-created workspace API keys, warns that they provide read/write access to sensitive resources, supports immediate revocation, requires TLS 1.2+, and limits API traffic to 200 requests per 10 seconds per workspace.
Hightouch documents GET https://api.hightouch.com/api/v1/models with Authorization: Bearer {API key}, a JSON model list, host allowlisting, and model-access troubleshooting.
Hightouch documents CLI surfaces for listing destinations, models, sources, syncs and runs plus triggering syncs; Relay does not mount the CLI or mutation surface.
Hightouch documents warehouse-direct model execution, encrypted traffic, regional processing, and limited operational/change-data-capture storage; Relay excludes all queried rows and customer data.

securityNotes: Relay encrypts the customer-owned key and sends it only as a Bearer credential to the fixed https://api.hightouch.com origin; it is never returned to agents.
Relay allowlists only GET /api/v1/models, rejects redirects, waits 30 seconds, caps the response at 1 MB, accepts no runtime input, and never paginates, polls, or retries automatically.
Output contains only the model count; model identity, SQL, configuration, sources, destinations, syncs, runs, profiles, events, row values, and customer data are excluded.

Hightouch keys have broader read/write authority than this wrapper; all triggers, tests, mutations, administration, raw APIs, CLI, MCP, and bulk remain structurally unavailable in both approval profiles.
Relay preserves Hightouch's 200-requests-per-10-seconds workspace limit and safe error categories without exposing response bodies.
Key creation, workspace/access confirmation, network policy review, secure capture, rotation/revocation planning, and live acceptance remain customer/external steps.
